items.name: theme
items.title: opencommerce theme
items.description: The opencommerce tokens and the Tailwind names that read them.

site.--ds-font-display: "Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro", "Neue Haas Grotesk Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
site.--ds-font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
site.--ds-font-code: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

items.name: about-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for company pages. Replace the sample people, links and content.
constraints: Photos in color beside gray ones
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components); the structure from agentcard.sh /about
items.title: About page
items.description: About page template with the header, the page's opening, team directories and the footer.

items.name: accordion
items.useFor: Use for FAQs or details that can stay collapsed, in a reading column (800px at most). Pull the list out by its row padding (-mx-4) so the questions line up with the heading. The WithTopics example adds topic tabs.
constraints: Borders or shadows around each question
More than one answer open by default
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable questions or sections with keyboard navigation.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.useFor: Use to confirm an action that is hard to undo (cancel an order, revoke an API key). Say what will happen in the description. Put the white AlertDialogCancel before the AlertDialogAction; set variant="destructive" on the action for something destructive. Set name for the title bar and size="sm" for a short, centered question with an AlertDialogMedia mark.
constraints: A confirmation for an action that can be undone
A close mark (it must be answered)
Vague actions such as OK and Yes
Two destructive actions in one dialog
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.win, .win-bar) and dialog.tsx
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A confirmation in one of the brand's windows: a title bar, a title, a line, and the white Cancel beside the blue or red action.

items.name: alert
items.useFor: Use inside a form, card or window for a note the reader should see in place: info for guidance, warning for something to check, destructive for a failure, success for a confirmation. Put a lucide glyph first, then AlertTitle and AlertDescription; add AlertAction for one small key. For a page-level notice with a title bar, use Banner.
constraints: A glyph and title in the same color as a warning
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (banner.tsx sheet and type, globals.css .win edge and the status badge colors)
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline notice: a white or pale blue sheet on the window edge with a blue glyph, a display-face title and muted detail.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.useFor: Use around images, video and screens that must keep their shape (a product shot, a merchant's preview). Round and clip the media inside with the window's corners and edge.
constraints: Stretching media to fill the ratio
A ratio frame with its own border style
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the windows' framed screens)
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Holds media at a fixed shape so the layout does not jump while it loads.

items.name: attachment
items.useFor: Use for files sent with a message or attached to an order: receipts, invoices, exports. Set state to idle, uploading, processing, error or done; add AttachmentActions with AttachmentAction keys (remove, retry, download) and AttachmentTrigger to open the file. Line several up in AttachmentGroup.
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (card.tsx small card, the merchant tiles, mono figures)
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file card: white on the 9 percent edge with 6px corners, its file in a pale blue tile, the name in 14px Inter and the size in the mono.

items.name: avatar
items.useFor: Use beside a person’s name or role. Provide alt text on AvatarImage. Use size="lg" for larger profiles.
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/monitoring.tsx (the merchant logo tile)
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A square photo or store mark with 6px corners and an initials fallback.

items.name: badge
items.useFor: Use chip for a plan tag, a count or an endpoint (Every merchant, POST /buy). Use the status pills for an order or route (Processing, then Confirmed in brand). Use tag, tag-ink and tag-heart for added, improved and fixed updates.
constraints: More than one tone per row
items.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/pricing.tsx (the plan chip), features.tsx and globals.css (.feat-pill, .feat-pill-wait, .feat-pill-done)
items.title: Badge
items.description: Mono chips for counts and tags, small pills for an order or route status.

items.name: banner
items.useFor: Use info for general notices, brand for announcements and alert for problems. Set name for the title bar and provide an action when one is needed.
constraints: More than one banner at a time
Banners for marketing copy that belongs in a section
items.title: Banner
items.description: Notice with a title, message and optional actions.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.useFor: Use on pages two or more levels deep (Orders, then an order, then a refund). Link every ancestor and end with BreadcrumbPage. For a long trail, fold the middle into a BreadcrumbEllipsis that opens a dropdown of the hidden steps.
constraints: A breadcrumb on a top-level page
The current page as a link
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits: muted ancestors, the page in ink, faint chevrons between them.

items.name: bubble
items.useFor: Use for the lines of an agent conversation, inside Message. Use default for the agent's own messages (align end), secondary for the person or store it talks to, tinted for another agent, muted for a system line, destructive for a message that failed. Group consecutive bubbles in BubbleGroup.
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the blue key, the window edge and mist, 12px window corners)
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A message bubble: the agent's own in the blue with white text, the other side on the mist, 12px corners with the tail squared.

items.name: button-group
items.useFor: Use to join related actions into one control (a split action, a pager, a copy key beside a field). Put Buttons, Inputs, Selects or ButtonGroupText inside; nest ButtonGroups for separated clusters; use orientation vertical for a stack.
constraints: Mixing blue and white keys without a separator
More than one primary key in a group
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the keys and the header's trays)
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Keys joined into one bar with shared edges, with mist mono text segments and fields.

items.name: button
items.useFor: Use one primary action per section. Pair it with secondary (Get started, then Read the docs); ghost in toolbars; on-brand only on a rare blue band. Wire an onClick handler, use type="submit" for forms, or use asChild with a link for navigation.
constraints: Two blue keys side by side for equal actions
A gradient or glow on a key
A drop shadow under a key
A key that sinks or lifts on press
items.title: Button
items.description: Flat keys for primary, secondary and toolbar actions.

items.name: calendar
items.useFor: Use inline when the dates are the content (a delivery window, an availability view); in a field use Date Picker. Choose mode single, multiple or range, disable days that cannot be picked, and set captionLayout to dropdown for dates far away.
constraints: Colors other than the blue for selection
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the keys, the pale blue of a highlighted row and the mono table figures)
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid of 36px keys: today in blue, the chosen day the blue key, a range on the pale blue.

items.name: card
items.useFor: Use default for a small group of related lines. Use raised for a card set on a picture (an order, a receipt). For code, plans and features use Window: the brand names its containers like files.
items.title: Card
items.description: Container for related content, with default and raised variants.

items.name: carousel
items.useFor: Use for a few related items people browse one at a time (merchant cards, screenshots of a checkout). Keep Previous and Next visible; use setApi to show the current slide. Set opts.loop to wrap around and orientation="vertical" for a column.
constraints: Hiding important content in later slides
A carousel for text people must read in full
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides that snap into place, with white keys to step through them.

items.name: chart
items.useFor: Use for figures over time or by category: orders per day, uptime, spend by merchant. Wrap a LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart or PieChart in ChartContainer with a config naming each series, then add ChartTooltip with ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegend with ChartLegendContent. Format figures with valueFormatter.
constraints: Charts that animate on every hover
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (features.tsx uptime and speed bars, monitoring.tsx)
items.title: Chart
items.description: SVG line, area, bar and donut charts with hairline rules, mono axis labels, the blue series first and a white tooltip.

items.name: checkbox
items.useFor: Use for multiple selections or a single agreement. Pair it with Label. When passing checked, update it through onCheckedChange.
constraints: Colors other than blue for checked
A checkbox for an action that happens at once (use a switch)
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked, indeterminate and disabled states.

items.name: code-block
items.useFor: Use when you need shadcn's composable code block: a header with CodeBlockTitle and CodeBlockActions (CodeBlockCopyButton), CodeBlockContent with code as a string, and an optional CodeBlockFooter. Pass dark on CodeBlock for code that runs, lineNumbers and highlight on the content. For a single snippet, CodeWindow does the same in one part.
constraints: A full syntax theme with many colors
A dark bar over light code
items.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/code-block.tsx; code-window.tsx (the same window, bar, tokenizer and colors)
items.title: Code Block
items.description: shadcn's code block as the brand's code window: the mist bar with the file name and Copy, the 13px mono body, light or on ink, with line numbers and banded lines.

items.name: code-window
items.useFor: Use for the code a page shows: the hero's setup file, a step's code, an API request. Pass code as a string for highlighting and copying, or pass rendered children. Light by default; dark for code that runs.
constraints: A full syntax theme with many colors
Horizontal scrolling for long lines (they wrap and hang)
items.title: Code window
items.description: Code in a window: the file name in the bar, Copy at the right, light or on ink, with banded lines.

items.name: collapse
items.useFor: Use for optional form fields, settings or details. Connect open to state and give the trigger aria-expanded and aria-controls.
items.title: Collapse
items.description: Expandable content area that animates its height.

items.name: collapsible
items.useFor: Use to tuck away secondary detail on a page (an order's line items, advanced checkout settings). Make the CollapsibleTrigger a row with its name and a CollapsibleChevron. For a list of questions use the accordion.
constraints: Hiding the main content of a page
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (the questions' slide) and accordion.tsx
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A section that slides open in place under a quiet row with a turning chevron.

items.name: combobox
items.useFor: Use to choose from a long list where typing is faster than scrolling (a merchant, a store's region). Pass items to Combobox and render ComboboxItem rows in ComboboxList, with a ComboboxInput search row. Set multiple and use ComboboxChips with ComboboxChipsInput for several values.
constraints: A combobox for under seven options (use Select)
Losing the typed text when the list closes
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the select field and the command palette)
items.title: Combobox
items.description: The select's field opening a searchable floating panel; chips in the field for several values.

items.name: command
items.useFor: Use Command for an inline list and CommandDialog for a palette. Connect each CommandItem onSelect to navigation or an action. Bind the dialog to Cmd/Ctrl K when needed.
constraints: A drop shadow on the panel
Icons in every row instead of a title and a line
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable command list or dialog with keyboard navigation.

items.name: context-menu
items.useFor: Use for shortcuts on an item in a list or table (copy an order ID, retry a checkout). Every action in it must also be reachable another way, such as a row's menu key. Use ContextMenuShortcut for keys, ContextMenuSub for one level of submenu and variant="destructive" on a destructive item.
constraints: The only way to reach an action
More than one level of submenu
A context menu on text people want to select
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.nav-tray) and dropdown-menu.tsx
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: The brand's menu opened with a right click or a long press on an item.

items.name: copy-button
items.useFor: Place beside a command, key or file and pass its value: in a window bar's corner, at the top right of a code card or in an install box. Use dark on ink. Use compact only where there is no room for the word.
constraints: A copy button without a label for screen readers
A key that changes width when it says Copied
items.title: Copy button
items.description: A small Copy key that swaps to Copied in place, on white or on ink.

items.name: cta
items.useFor: Use once near the end of the home page, in a wide SiteSection. Pass the primary and secondary Buttons as actions and InstallTabs as media.
constraints: A gradient or glow behind the headline
items.title: CTA
items.description: The closing card: mist, a hairline and 16px corners, the headline, two keys and the install box, glyphs gathering at its edges.

items.name: data-table
items.useFor: Use for records people sort, filter, select and page through (orders, merchants, API keys). Describe each column with an id, a header, an accessor for sorting and filtering, and a cell to render it; set sortable on the columns that can be sorted. Set selectable for a checkbox column and pageSizes to offer rows per page. Put bulk actions in toolbar.
constraints: A data table for fewer than ten rows (use the table)
Animating rows when sorting or paging
items.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/monitoring.tsx (the merchant table) with table.tsx and pagination.tsx
items.title: Data Table
items.description: The brand's table with a search field, sortable heads, row selection, a Columns menu and page keys.

items.name: date-picker
items.useFor: Use for a date in a form or filter (a key's expiry, an order's date range). Use DateRangePicker for ranges; give presets for common choices (Today, Last 7 days). Give it a name for FormData; the value posts as YYYY-MM-DD.
constraints: A free-text date field without a picker
A picker that stays open after a single date is chosen
Presets that do not match the calendar's selection
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the select field and the floating panel)
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: The select's field with a calendar glyph, opening a calendar in the floating panel, with optional presets.

items.name: dialog
items.useFor: Use for a short form or confirmation. Provide a title and description. Set name for the title bar and size for wider content. Connect form submission and validation to the application.
constraints: A dialog opened from another dialog
Sliding in from an edge (use a sheet)
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with a title bar, focus trap and close control.

items.name: direction
items.useFor: Wrap a right-to-left region (Arabic or Hebrew content) in DirectionProvider with dir="rtl", and set dir on the element too, so menus, sliders and tabs flip.
constraints: Mirroring a layout with CSS alone
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left reading for every component inside it.

items.name: docs-link
items.useFor: Use to link to a guide or reference in a new tab. Provide the destination URL and a descriptive label.
constraints: Arrows on links that stay on the site
items.title: Docs link
items.description: External documentation link with an arrow.

items.name: drawer
items.useFor: Use on phones for a short task or a choice that belongs to the page under it (pick a shipping address, review a cart). Set direction for top, left or right; bottom is the default. Mark a scrolling list inside it with data-drawer-no-drag so scrolling does not drag the drawer.
constraints: A drawer on desktop for a long form (use a sheet or dialog)
Content that needs the full height of the screen
A drawer opened from another drawer
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.win) and sheet.tsx
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A window pulled from an edge with a handle, that can be dragged away.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.useFor: Use for actions on an item or a compact navigation menu. Set variant="glass" for a menu that opens from the header's glass tray. Use onSelect for actions and DropdownMenuHoldItem for destructive actions that require a hold.
constraints: Menus for navigation that should be visible
More than one level of submenu
A destructive row that fires on one click
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Action menu with white and frosted glass panels, submenus and selection controls.

items.name: empty-state
items.useFor: Explain what is missing and provide the next action. Set name for the title bar or null to hide it. Connect actions such as creating an item or clearing a search.
constraints: Empty states that blame the reader
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Message and optional action for an empty list or search result.

items.name: empty
items.useFor: Use when a list, search or panel has nothing to show. Put it inside a Window (or use EmptyState) when it stands for a whole list. Give it EmptyMedia with variant icon and a lucide glyph, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription and one action in EmptyContent.
constraints: An empty state without a way forward
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (empty-state.tsx body, the merchant tiles in features.tsx)
items.title: Empty
items.description: A quiet centered message for an empty list: an optional merchant-tile mark, a display-face title, one muted line and the next action.

items.name: faq
items.useFor: Pass title, lead and items (question and answer). Put it in a medium SiteSection just above the footer, with bottom padding.
constraints: Answers longer than a short paragraph
A chevron in place of the drawn +
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Centered questions with native expandable answers, one open at a time, on hairlines.

items.name: feature-rows
items.useFor: Use FeatureGrid for the home page's four features in a medium SiteSection, FeatureRows for a product page that needs more room. Draw each picture from the page's own parts and key its motion off group-data-[state=…]/feature.
constraints: More than one blue voice in a picture
A move that does not end on the finished frame
More than six features in the grid
items.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/features.tsx, src/components/feature-play.tsx, src/app/globals.css (THE FEATURE PICTURES)
items.title: Feature rows
items.description: Features as windows two to a row (picture, title, line), or one to a row beside their window; pictures play when first seen.

items.name: field
items.useFor: Wrap Input, Textarea, TagsInput or SelectTrigger. Derive error from the current value and clear it when valid. Use required for required fields and htmlFor when the control has an explicit id.
constraints: Labels inside the field as placeholders
items.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/monitoring.tsx (#merchant-filter); labels are an extension
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, help text, error message and accessibility attributes for a form control.

items.name: form
items.useFor: Use for any form with validation. Create the form with useForm, wrap it in Form, and give each control a FormField with FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl around the control, and FormDescription or FormMessage under it. Validation rules go in FormField's rules or a resolver.
constraints: Validating on every keystroke before the first submit
Hiding the error message in a tooltip
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the Field: label, control, hint)
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form wired to the brand's field layout: a 12px muted label, the control, a hint or a red message.

items.name: glyph-field
items.useFor: Put it behind the hero's code window (fade out, spilling past the card) or inside the closing card (fade in, gathering at the edges). Position it absolutely in a relative, isolated parent and keep it under the content.
constraints: More than three fields on a page
Blue as the main color of the field
A field on a dark ground
items.title: Glyph field
items.description: A faint canvas field of *s and @s in clumps, with a few blue runs, that flickers while on screen.

items.name: hero
items.useFor: Use at the top of the home page. Pass the primary and secondary Buttons as actions, LogoStrip as strip and a CodeWindow as media. Use titleClassName to adjust wrapping for a longer headline.
constraints: An image in place of the code
The glyph field over the title
items.title: Hero
items.description: White, centered page opening: a pill, the title, a line, two keys, the strip of marks and a code window over a field of glyphs.

items.name: hold-button
items.useFor: Use for destructive actions such as cancelling an order or closing a card. Connect onConfirm to the action. Releasing early, leaving the control or losing focus cancels the hold.
constraints: Hold for actions that can be undone
A blue fill for a destructive action
items.title: Hold button
items.description: Button that confirms an action after a continuous hold.

items.name: home-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for an opencommerce landing page. Replace the sample content and pictures, and check every link.
constraints: A window bar on the hero's pill
Sections out of this order without a reason
items.title: Home page
items.description: Home page template: header, hero, features, steps, live status, pricing, closing card, questions and footer.

items.name: hover-card
items.useFor: Use to preview what a link points to without leaving the page (a merchant's status, an order's items). The trigger must still work as a link on its own; the card is for sighted pointer users only, so never put the only copy of anything in it.
constraints: Actions or forms inside the card (use a popover)
A hover card on a button
The only way to reach information
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.win) and popover.tsx
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview of a merchant, an order or a person that opens beside a link under the pointer.

items.name: input-group
items.useFor: Use when something belongs inside the field: a search mark, a unit or domain (segment), a copy or clear key, a count. Put InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea inside InputGroup and InputGroupAddon at either end (inline-start, inline-end) or above or below a textarea (block-start, block-end).
constraints: A second border around the inner control
Addons that are not clickable but look like keys
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the input, the search field and the merchant filter in monitoring.live)
items.title: Input Group
items.description: The brand's field with glyphs, text, keys or a mist mono segment inside its edge.

items.name: input-otp
items.useFor: Use for a one-time code (a login code, a card verification). Set maxLength and pattern (REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS for numbers), split long codes into groups with InputOTPSeparator, and handle onComplete. Pasting a whole code fills every slot.
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Joined 40px slots on the hairline, one character each in the platform mono, the active slot on the blue edge.

items.name: input
items.useFor: Use inside Field for a label and validation message. Set an appropriate input type. Use variant="search" for search or filtering and connect changes to the results.
constraints: Placeholder text as the only label
A glow or ring on focus (the edge turns blue)
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field with standard and search variants.

items.name: install-tabs
items.useFor: Use under a closing call to action or in a getting-started section, for the one command that installs the SDK. Pass one entry per package manager.
constraints: More than one command per tab
Tabs that change anything but the command
items.title: Install tabs
items.description: One install line on ink, a tab per package manager and a Copy key.

items.name: integrations
items.useFor: Pass rows with a title, description and options. Each option supplies a label, icon and panel. Use IntegrationCode and IntegrationScreen to build the preview.
constraints: More than six tools in one row
Light code windows on the stage
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (its windows, keys and code; opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/window.tsx, in-action.tsx); the layout from agentcard.sh / (.v7-intg-row)
items.title: Integrations
items.description: Integration sections with selectable tools and matching previews.

items.name: item
items.useFor: Use for lists of things a reader scans and acts on: merchants, orders, agents, files. Group rows in ItemGroup with ItemSeparator between them. Use asChild with a link to make a row navigate; mark the current row with aria-current.
constraints: Two primary keys in one row
Rows with no rule or card between them in a long list
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (monitoring.tsx rows, in-action.tsx step list, card.tsx)
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of content: an ink title over a muted line, with a merchant-tile mark and actions; bare, outlined as a small card or on the mist.

items.name: kbd
items.useFor: Use in control hints, menu items and command palette instructions. The bare variant is for compact search hints.
constraints: Keys for things that are not keys
Keys in body copy larger than the text around them
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key or shortcut label.

items.name: label
items.useFor: Use the default form label above an input. Use variant=control for the larger label beside a checkbox, switch or radio. Connect htmlFor to the control id, or use Field to connect it automatically.
constraints: Labels without a control to point at
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/monitoring.tsx (table head labels)
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible label for a form control.

items.name: logo-strip
items.useFor: Pass the brands with an image src (drawn as a mask, so any color works), a mark node in currentColor, or just a name. Use once, in the hero.
constraints: Tiles or borders around the marks
items.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/logo-strip.tsx, src/components/merchant-logo.tsx, src/app/globals.css (THE LOGO STRIP, .logo-mask)
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: The stores or customers as bare grey marks drifting left in one row under the hero's keys.

items.name: logo
items.useFor: Use Lockup in headers and footers (compact once the header scrolls), and LogoMark in tight spots: an app icon, an avatar, a favicon-sized slot. Set label={null} when the containing link already has an accessible name.
constraints: The name set in another face or weight
The byline larger than the name
A drop shadow or glow behind the logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The typeset opencommerce lockup with its byline, and the [*] mark.

items.name: marker
items.useFor: Use to mark time or state in a conversation or a log: separator for a day (Today), unread for where new messages start, border for a heading over a group. Put a lucide glyph in MarkerIcon and the words in MarkerContent.
constraints: Colors other than muted ink and the blue
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (window bar and chart labels in the platform mono)
items.title: Marker
items.description: A small mono label in a conversation or list: plain, centered between rules, ruled underneath, or the blue unread rule.

items.name: marquee
items.useFor: Use under the hero's actions for the stores, customers or partners a product reaches; LogoStrip wraps it for marks. Use at most one per page.
constraints: Logos in color on the strip
Two running strips on one page
Text a reader must read to act
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A slow strip of grey marks or names drifting left, fading at both ends, paused under the pointer.

items.name: menubar
items.useFor: Use in a tool where people work for a long time and expect desktop menus (an order console). Keep to a few menus with short names. Arrow keys move between menus and through their items.
constraints: A menubar as site navigation (use navigation menu)
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.btn-secondary, .nav-tray) and dropdown-menu.tsx
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A white bar of menus (Orders, View, Help) like a desktop app's, each opening the brand's menu.

items.name: message-scroller
items.useFor: Use to hold a conversation that grows: MessageScroller with MessageScrollerViewport, MessageScrollerContent and one MessageScrollerItem per message, plus MessageScrollerButton. Set scrollAnchor on the message just sent. Wrap the composer in MessageScrollerProvider when its send key needs useMessageScroller.
constraints: Scrolling the page instead of the conversation
Auto-scrolling while the reader is reading older messages
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the secondary key and floating drop)
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A conversation's scroll area that stays on the newest message and offers the white Jump to latest key when the reader scrolls up.

items.name: message
items.useFor: Use for each turn of an agent conversation: MessageAvatar, then MessageContent holding MessageHeader (the name, then a time element), the Bubble parts and an optional MessageFooter (Delivered). Set align end for the agent's own messages. Stack turns in MessageGroup or MessageScroller.
items.title: Message
items.description: One message: a 32px square avatar, the sender with the time in mono, the bubbles and a mono footer, mirrored for the agent's own.

items.name: native-select
items.useFor: Use where the platform picker serves better than a custom list: long lists on phones, forms that must work without script. Pair it with a Field or Label and give it a name. Use Select for a styled list.
constraints: A custom arrow on top of the browser's own
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the input and select field)
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The browser's own select in the brand's field: 36px, 8px corners, the hairline and the drawn chevron.

items.name: nav-dock
items.useFor: SiteHeader renders it from its links; use it alone only for a custom header. Link on-page sections by #id so the pill follows the reader, or set spy={false} and mark the current page.
constraints: A dark glass tray on the white page
Moving the pill with a spring
items.title: Nav dock
items.description: The header's tray of links in frosted glass, with a lit pill that slides to the current section.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.useFor: Use for a site's main navigation when some entries open a panel of related links (Product, Developers). Give each link in a panel a title and a NavigationMenuLinkDescription. Set tray for the header's glass tray, and active on the current page's link.
constraints: Actions in the menu (use a dropdown menu)
Panels with more than eight links
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site links with panels, drawn as the header's links, optionally in its frosted tray.

items.name: outline-wordmark
items.useFor: Use once, along the bottom edge of the site footer, with the product's name in its own case.
constraints: The wordmark anywhere but the footer
A tagline in place of the name
items.title: Outline wordmark
items.description: The name set as wide as the page in a faint outline, lit in blue under the pointer.

items.name: page-header
items.useFor: Place below SiteHeader on company, form, legal or update pages. Put supporting title content in children.
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (.h-hero type, mono labels and hairlines; opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css)
items.title: Page header
items.description: Title, optional label and introduction for an inner page.

items.name: pagination
items.useFor: Use under a table or list that is split into pages. Show the first and last pages, the current one and its neighbors, with PaginationEllipsis between. Mark the current page with isActive and an unavailable Previous or Next with aria-disabled.
constraints: Pagination for fewer than two pages
Numbered pages for a live feed (load more instead)
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.btn-secondary) and monitoring.tsx
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page keys under a table: the current page a white key, the others bare, Previous and Next with chevrons.

items.name: popover
items.useFor: Use for explanations, filters or small controls. Use variant="glass" over imagery or the header. Keep longer tasks in Dialog or Sheet.
constraints: Forms longer than a few fields (use a dialog)
Popovers that open on hover (use a tooltip)
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored panel for contextual details or controls.

items.name: pricing-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for a pricing page. Set the current plans, values and action URLs.
items.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/pricing.tsx, faq.tsx (as a page of its own)
items.title: Pricing page
items.description: Pricing page template with the plans, billing questions and the footer.

items.name: pricing
items.useFor: Pass title, description, the compared rows and two plans with one value per row. Feature at most one plan.
constraints: Check lists in place of compared rows
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Plans side by side in windows, with the figure, compared rows and a full-width key; one plan featured.

items.name: product-grid
items.useFor: Pass products with title, description, action and media. Use layout="lead" for a full-width card and layout="half" for paired cards.
constraints: An odd number of half cards
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (its windows, mist insets and keys; opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css .win); the layout from agentcard.sh / (.v7-sol)
items.title: Product grid
items.description: Product overview cards with text, actions and media.

items.name: progress
items.useFor: Use for spending limits, uploads or setup progress. Update value as progress changes and set max when the scale is not 100. Give the bar an accessible label.
constraints: Progress without a label saying what it measures
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/features.tsx (the speed race bars)
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar with a value, maximum and accessible progress state.

items.name: prose
items.useFor: Use for documentation, guides, legal content and release notes. Pass semantic HTML or rendered Markdown. Use wide for a wider content column.
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (its type, hairlines, code and mono labels; opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css); the structure from agentcard.sh/terms
items.title: Prose
items.description: Typography and layout for long-form content.

items.name: questionnaire
items.useFor: Use for a short set of questions with set answers (onboarding an agent, a checkout preference survey). Pass items with name, required and multiple; for each, a QuestionnaireItem with a title, choices (QuestionnaireChoice), an optional QuestionnaireInput and QuestionnaireError; finish with QuestionnaireActions (Previous, Skip, Next, Submit). Read the answers from FormData on submit.
constraints: More than one question on screen
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (in-action.tsx step list, checkbox.tsx, the keys)
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questions asked one at a time: choice keys on the hairline that take the pale blue when chosen, a mono progress count and the blue Next key.

items.name: radio-group
items.useFor: Use for one choice among two to five options that should stay visible (a checkout mode, a shipping speed). Label every option with a Label (variant control) beside its circle, and give the group a name for FormData. For more options use Select; for a compact row of choices use Toggle Group.
constraints: A radio for a yes or no setting (use Switch)
A filled blue circle with no white ring
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the checkbox and the blue key)
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: 18px white circles on the hairline; the chosen one takes the blue edge and a blue dot.

items.name: resizable
items.useFor: Use for a split view people adjust (a request and its response, an order list and its detail). Give each ResizablePanel a defaultSize and limits in percent; add withHandle to the ResizableHandle when the rule alone is too easy to miss.
constraints: Panels that can shrink to nothing without a way back
More than three panels in a row
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.win, the 9 percent ink rules)
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by a 9 percent ink rule that can be dragged or moved with the arrow keys.

items.name: scroll-area
items.useFor: Use for a list or log inside a fixed-height window or panel.
constraints: Hiding the main content in one
Scrolling the whole page in one
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Scrollable container with overflow indicators and a scroll control.

items.name: secret-field
items.useFor: Use for API keys or card details. Provide a descriptive label. Use defaultRevealed only when the value should initially be visible.
constraints: Showing a secret in full by default
items.title: Secret field
items.description: Masked value with reveal and copy controls.

items.name: section
items.useFor: Use SiteSection for each band of the page and SectionHeading to open it. Pick width medium (800px) for features, pricing and questions, wide (1200px) for a table, the steps or the closing card. Add bottom padding only to the section that closes the page.
constraints: Left-aligned section titles over centered content
Two tinted sections in a row
items.title: Section
items.description: Page section with generous air above, the centered section heading and an optional label.

items.name: segmented-control
items.useFor: Use for a small set of options such as a billing period or a package manager. Connect value and onValueChange. Use size="sm" in compact layouts and variant="plain" in toolbars.
constraints: Switching between pages or panels (use tabs)
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Single-value selector with radio semantics and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: select
items.useFor: Use the field appearance inside Field for forms. Use compact in dense rows and ghost or chip for filters. Field required is inherited by Select. Give Select a name for FormData; keep value and onValueChange on the root. Use compact on SelectContent for compact fields and toolbar menus.
constraints: Long lists without a search (use a command)
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-choice select with field, compact, ghost and chip treatments.

items.name: separator
items.useFor: Use between related content groups or inline controls.
constraints: Rules between every row of a card
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider.

items.name: sheet
items.useFor: Use for item details, activity logs or longer forms. Choose right, left or bottom with side. Set modal={false} when the rest of the page must remain interactive.
constraints: Sheets for a quick confirmation (use a dialog)
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Side panel with a title, close control and focus management.

items.name: sidebar
items.useFor: Use for an app's main navigation (an order console, a developer dashboard). Wrap the page in SidebarProvider with the Sidebar and a SidebarInset beside it; put the wordmark or a switcher in SidebarHeader, groups of SidebarMenu rows in SidebarContent and the account in SidebarFooter. Mark the current row with isActive. Set collapsible="icon" to let it narrow to glyphs (give rows a tooltip), floating or inset for the window looks. On phones it opens in the sheet; Cmd or Ctrl and B toggles it.
constraints: A sidebar on a marketing page
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app's rail: a white column with a rule at its edge, quiet rows, mono group labels and the pale blue current row.

items.name: site-footer
items.useFor: Use once at the foot of every page. Provide link groups (three reads best), the description and the small print; check that every link resolves.
items.title: Site footer
items.description: White footer under a hairline: the name and a line, three link columns, the small print and the outlined wordmark.

items.name: site-header
items.useFor: Use once at the top of every page with the page's sections as links (#features) and the main action. Set fixed={false} inside a frame or preview.
constraints: A white key in the header
A sticky header (fixed with a spacer instead)
items.title: Site header
items.description: Fixed header of three glass trays: the wordmark, the links with their pill, and one blue key.

items.name: skeleton
items.useFor: Match the expected content dimensions and replace it when loading completes.
constraints: Skeletons for content that loads at once
Gray blocks that do not match the final layout
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder that reserves space while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.useFor: Use to set a number in a known range where the rough value matters more than the exact one (a per-order budget, a retry count). Show the current value beside it in the platform mono. Pass two values for a range, and set step for whole units.
constraints: A slider for an exact amount the user must type
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the switch key and the speed bars in speed.feature)
items.title: Slider
items.description: A 4px rule filled with the blue up to the value, with a small white key you drag or step with the arrow keys.

items.name: sonner
items.useFor: Mount one Toaster near the application root. Show a toast after an action succeeds or fails. Connect any toast action to its intended behavior.
constraints: Toasts for errors that need an answer (use a dialog or a banner)
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast notifications with optional actions.

items.name: spinner
items.useFor: Use during a pending operation. Pair it with a label, prevent duplicate submissions when needed and restore the control when the operation finishes.
constraints: Colored spinners that ignore their text
items.source: Extension using the site text colors and reduced-motion behavior; no standalone spinner found on the current public site
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator that inherits the surrounding text color.

items.name: status-table
items.useFor: Use for live health of the things a product depends on (stores, routes, providers), in a wide SiteSection. Pass the columns, one value per column per row, and the day history.
constraints: Red and green bars (the brand's blue only)
items.title: Status table
items.description: A live table in a window: a live dot and filter, rows with marks, mono figures and day bars, a legend.

items.name: steps
items.useFor: Use once on the home page, in a wide SiteSection, for three to six steps from first call to result. Each step carries the code that does it.
constraints: A timer faster than 4 seconds a step
items.title: Steps
items.description: How it works: steps listed down the left, each with its code in a dark window, playing through on a timer.

items.name: surface
items.useFor: Wrap an area with the white or mist ground (the closing card, an inset) so content and overlays use matching colors.
constraints: A blue ground for a section (the page is white throughout)
items.title: Surface
items.description: Background and text context shared by a section and its overlays.

items.name: switch
items.useFor: Pair with Label. Connect checked and onCheckedChange when the application owns the setting.
constraints: Colors other than blue for on
A switch inside a form that needs a submit (use a checkbox)
items.title: Switch
items.description: Toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.

items.name: table
items.useFor: Use for live records (merchants, routes, orders) or a plan comparison. Set figures in the mono (font-mono text-snippet). Give each TableCell after the first a label for the mobile layout. Use Badge for statuses.
constraints: Tables nested in a card (the table is its own frame; inside a Window drop its frame with your own classes)
items.title: Table
items.description: Responsive table that stacks row content on phones.

items.name: tabs
items.useFor: Use for related views such as plans, FAQ topics or item details. Give each TabsTrigger a matching TabsContent. Use glide={false} when supplying a custom selected state.
constraints: A blue key as the selected tab
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed views in the header's glass tray: a white pill glides to the selected tab.

items.name: tag-filter
items.useFor: Connect onAddTag and onRemoveTag to the filter state, then apply those filters to the results.
constraints: Filters that hide which tags are on
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/pricing.tsx (the plan chip), monitoring.tsx (#merchant-filter)
items.title: Tag filter
items.description: Searchable tag picker with removable selected filters.

items.name: tags-input
items.useFor: Use inside Field for domains, emails or similar values. Enter or comma adds a value; Backspace removes the last value when the input is empty. Provide isTagInvalid for validation.
constraints: Tags without a way to remove them
Free text that should be a textarea
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/monitoring.tsx (#merchant-filter), pricing.tsx (the plan chip)
items.title: Tags input
items.description: Editable list of values with add, remove and validation states.

items.name: team-directory
items.useFor: Use for teams, advisors, investors or partners. Provide current names and links.
constraints: Cards with gaps between people instead of the ruled grid
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (its windows, hairlines and mono labels; opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/window.tsx); the grid from agentcard.sh/about
items.title: Team directory
items.description: Responsive directory of people with photos, roles and optional links.

items.name: testimonials
items.useFor: Pass cases with name, logo, quote, context and tag. Use approved customer quotes and attribution.
constraints: More than one quote per window
Photos in place of the company's mark
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (its windows and mono tags; opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/window.tsx, pricing.tsx)
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Customer quotes with names, logos and optional context.

items.name: textarea
items.useFor: Use inside Field for messages, notes and other longer input. Connect value and onChange when the form owns the state.
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Resizable multi-line text field.

items.name: toast
items.useFor: Prefer Sonner for new work. Use this when an app already uses the toast() and useToast() API: mount one Toaster near the root, call toast({ title, description, action }) and use variant="destructive" for a failure. Give an action an altText that says what it does.
constraints: A toast for an error that needs a decision (use an alert dialog)
items.source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components (the order card's done step) and sonner.tsx
items.title: Toast
items.description: The older Radix toast in the look of the brand's Sonner toasts: a white card at the bottom left with a blue action.

items.name: toggle-group
items.useFor: Use type="single" for one view or filter among a few (Live, Failed, All) and type="multiple" for filters that combine. Use variant outline with spacing 0 for a joined bar of white keys. Prefer Tabs when each option shows its own panel.
constraints: More than six options in the tray
Blue filled keys for the chosen option
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the header's trays and the segmented control)
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: The header's frosted tray of options with the chosen one a white key and a blue label, or separate white keys.

items.name: toggle
items.useFor: Use for an on or off option that acts at once in a toolbar (show live routes only, pin a merchant). Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label. Use outline when the toggle sits among white keys.
constraints: A toggle for a setting saved later (use Switch or Checkbox)
Blue fill for the pressed state
An icon that moves when pressed
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the keys and the header's trays)
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A 34px key that stays pressed: a quiet label on the wash, or a white key that lights blue.

items.name: tooltip
items.useFor: Use to explain an icon control or add brief context. Keep a separate accessible name on the control; do not put essential instructions only in the tooltip.
constraints: Tooltips for anything needed to finish a task
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short contextual label shown on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: trace
items.useFor: Use to show what an agent did or is doing: one TraceLine per step with a TraceIcon, TraceTitle and TraceDescription (a duration). Set status running, pending or error. Wrap a step in TraceCollapsible with a trigger and content to reveal its detail (the request, the response).
constraints: Details open by default for every step
items.source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (in-action.tsx steps, monitoring.tsx log, the rule)
items.title: Trace
items.description: An agent's steps as lines of muted 14px text with glyphs, mono durations, a breathing running step and details that open from a hairline.

items.name: typography
items.useFor: Use for text a page writes by hand, outside Prose: headings with TypographyH1 to H4, body with TypographyP, the line under a heading with TypographyLead, inline code with TypographyInlineCode. For a whole article from markdown, use Prose.
items.title: Typography
items.description: The brand type as parts: display-face headings at 500 tracked tight, 16px Inter body, muted leads, blue-marked lists, mono inline code.

items.name: updates-feed
items.useFor: Use for changelogs or activity updates. Provide dates, change groups and optional media. Place in a Prose column or another readable content width.
constraints: Colors other than blue ink and red for tags
items.source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (mono tags, hairlines; opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/pricing.tsx chip); the structure from agentcard.sh/updates
items.title: Updates feed
items.description: Dated release notes grouped by change type.

items.name: use-hold
items.useFor: Use for hold-to-confirm controls. Spread handlers on the control and use isHolding for its visual state. Pass disabled to prevent confirmation.
constraints: Hold for actions that can be undone
items.title: useHold
items.description: Confirms after a continuous pointer or keyboard hold and cancels when interrupted.

items.name: use-tab-glide
items.useFor: Use for a shared selection indicator in a row of options. The indicator is measured from the parent’s outer edge; account for the border when positioning it.
constraints: Animating the key with a timed transition that restarts when interrupted
items.title: useTabGlide
items.description: Moves a selection indicator between tabs, respecting reduced motion.

items.name: utils
items.useFor: Use cn to combine component classes and caller overrides.
items.title: cn
items.description: Class-name utilities that understand the design token scales.

items.name: window
items.useFor: Use for the things a page shows off: code (agent.ts), plans (free.plan), a live table (monitoring.live), a feature's picture. Name the bar like a file. Use dark for code that runs.
constraints: A window bar on every card of a page
Colored or blue bars on the page's main windows
items.title: Window
items.description: A white card with a quiet title bar: file name centered, the [*] mark or an action at the right.
